# SPEC section 1 — what has physics, and NOTHING else: ears, hair (root anchored),
# strands, breasts, goggles, what hangs. The chains below are DERIVED from the rig by
# name pattern + hierarchy (a chain is the maximal single-child path from its group
# root), never hand-listed; the owner table is only an assertion inside the generator.
# KEIRA ONLY: no other model gets data until the owner has validated her.
#
# family A = what she IS (ears, hair, strands, breasts): SPEC section 4, at rest it
#            returns EXACTLY to the model pose, so it carries NO static sag —
#            gravity=0.00 and hang=0.00 are asserted for every family A chain.
# family B = what she WEARS (goggles, straps, flaps): SPEC section 4 exception, what
#            hangs stays hung — gravity>0 and hang>0 are asserted for every one.
# rootlock=1 on every chain of 2+ joints EXCEPT the breast (SPEC section 2: the root
#            rides its carrier bone rigidly — that is a STRAND, whose root joint
#            overlaps the skull); omitted on 1-joint chains, where the parser default
#            is 0, and omitted on chestL/chestR, where SPEC 30 puts the anchor in the
#            TISSUE ("no hard attachment boundary") and where 75% of the chain mass
#            sits on the root link — pinning it would freeze three quarters of the
#            organ. The rigid anchor there is `chest`, which is OUTSIDE the chain.
# radius/radii = MEASURED off the skinned mesh, in GAME UNITS (4096 = 1 m): per link,
#            the inner-quartile (25..75 pct) mean of the perpendicular distance from
#            the vertices that link owns to its bone axis, in that link's bind space.
# stiffness (Hz) / damping (0..1) / mass / couple are the only hand-chosen numbers;
#            they are tuning constants and the owner retunes them here.
#
# The `# <chain> ... verts= wsum= r=` line above each chain is the mesh-influence gate:
# a joint with ZERO skinned vertices owns no drawn geometry. A chain is ABANDONED only
# when ALL of its joints are in that state — there is then nothing visible for it to
# move. One empty joint inside a chain that has geometry KEEPS its link and inherits a
# radius from the next link, else the previous one, else the chain median, written on
# the chain line as FALLBACK-FROM=<source>. Every zero-vertex joint, both cases:
#   DROPPED belt: all 1 joint(s) (belt) have 0 skinned vertices
#   FALLBACK topstrapL.lTopStrap: 0 skinned vertices, radius from lTopStrap2
#   FALLBACK topstrapR.rTopStrap: 0 skinned vertices, radius from rTopStrap2

# ---- COLLIDERS, fitted from the same mesh. One capsule per obstacle bone segment,
# one sphere per obstacle joint no capsule caps (a part root: a strand hanging off the
# skull, a breast off the chest, the pelvis). A capsule never spans two parts: a swept
# sphere from a hub centre out to an appendage root is a volume the character has not
# got. SPEC section 3: the ears, the strands and the breasts are simulated AND are
# obstacles. NO chains= / at= filter on any of them (DIRECTIVES rule 4): every volume
# applies to every chain and the engine decides geometrically what touches what.
# Each volume carries the vertex count and weight threshold it was fitted from.
# capsule hips->main [body]  hips: 479v @w>0.5   main: 43v @w>0.25
#   COUVERTURE: hips 115v dans le segment, couverture p95=1035 contre 810 livre (x0.78) | main SPAN-EMPTY (aucun sommet ne se projette dans le segment: la distance perpendiculaire y mesure une autre partie, rayon inter-quartile conserve)
capsule hips main radius=810 radius2=549
# capsule chest->main [body]  chest: 782v @w>0.5   main: 43v @w>0.25
#   COUVERTURE: chest 30v dans le segment, couverture p95=601 contre 643 livre (x1.07) | main 43v dans le segment, couverture p95=676 contre 549 livre (x0.81)
capsule chest main radius=643 radius2=549
# capsule neck->chest [body]  neck: 37v @w>0.5   chest: 782v @w>0.5   ONE-JOINT-ONE-THICKNESS: neck 246->249 (span-empty -> own-bone thickness neck->head, 37v)
#   COUVERTURE: neck SPAN-EMPTY (aucun sommet ne se projette dans le segment: la distance perpendiculaire y mesure une autre partie, rayon inter-quartile conserve) | chest 677v dans le segment, couverture p95=922 contre 643 livre (x0.70)

# capsule head->neck [body]  head: 1559v @w>0.5   neck: 37v @w>0.5
